title: MP Rojgar Panjiyan 2025
organization: Madhya Pradesh Employment Exchange / MP Online
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rojgar.mponline.gov.in or related MP employment portal
2. New user registration with mobile OTP
3. Fill educational and skill details
4. Upload photo and documents
5. Submit and download registration slip
shortDescription: MP Rojgar Panjiyan 2025 – free employment registration for job seekers on Madhya Pradesh Rojgar / MP Online portal.
content:
MP Rojgar Panjiyan is the employment exchange registration for job seekers in Madhya Pradesh.

Unemployed youth can register online, update qualifications and get notified about government and private job opportunities linked with the employment portal. Keep Aadhaar, education certificates and mobile number ready.
